verdict.rationale: Trivy's CLI can scan a filesystem or git repo for secrets and vulnerabilities and exits non-zero on findings (trivy-docs-3, trivy-probe-6, trivy-probe-8), which is the technical basis needed for a pre-commit hook, but the evidence pack never documents an official `.pre-commit-hooks.yaml`/pre-commit framework integration or guidance for wiring Trivy into git pre-commit specifically. missing for 10: explicit pre-commit hook manifest/config docs, guidance on git-commit-time invocation, and community confirmation it works well as a pre-commit gate.
